# secureaccess_dlp_custom_data_identifier (Data Source)

This data source reads the DLP Custom Data Identifier.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "secureaccess_dlp_custom_data_identifier" "example" {
  id = "76d24097-41c4-4558-a4d0-a8c07ac08470"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Id of the object
- `name` (String) Name of the DLP Custom Data Identifier.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description of the DLP Custom Identifier.
- `patterns` (Set of String) The set of regex patterns for the custom data identifier. Each pattern must be at least three characters long and cannot start with ^ or end with $.  `terms` and/or `patterns` must be provided.
- `proximity` (Set of String) Proximity values.
- `terms` (Set of String) Terms for the custom data identifier. `terms` and/or `patterns` must be provided.
- `threshold_ranges` (Attributes List) Threshold ranges for the custom data identifier. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--threshold_ranges))
- `unique_threshold` (Boolean) Whether to count only unique matches.

<a id="nestedatt--threshold_ranges"></a>
### Nested Schema for `threshold_ranges`

Read-Only:

- `maximum` (Number) Maximum threshold value. Use `-1` for no maximum.
- `minimum` (Number) Minimum threshold value.
- `severity` (String) Severity level of the threshold range. One of ["very-low", "low", "medium", "high", "critical"] or any custom value.'
